go_baseline.policy: Go retains baseline continuation semantics; shared account installation profiles and transport isolation are applied to both engines

required_invariants: Go/Rust在各网关范围内共享持久化归属与完整历史；各profile保持隔离，保留客户端Thread和密文
无归属但完整自包含的客户端历史自动接纳，不需要人工授权；仅缺登记不能拒绝未知密文
未知输入仅在完整有效成功响应后补记归属；准备、预热、失败、取消及输出修补不能伪造成功证据
自动续接遵守既有有界重试、账号池与输出前回退规则；失败保留历史和密文，不覆盖已成功代次
Go/Rust共用自动续接内核；人工恢复IPC、授权文件、claim与单次尝试分支已移除，旧完成记录仅读取兼容
Go/Rust共享持久化安装身份；OAuth刷新不轮换身份；账号主体或APIkey更换不混用连接
Go/Rust保留已知caller/account/owner隔离；未知服务器引用先尝试checkpoint补全，缺少完整历史时真实失败

account_installation_alignment.scope: account installation and HTTP/WS transport; shared automatic history admission preserves caller isolation and immutable original cipher provenance
constraints: Go preserves existing session/thread and opaque continuation semantics; no new unknown-upstream 409 gate
Complete unknown history is admitted automatically; existing caller/account provenance remains isolated and full-history replay does not transfer original ownership
Only actual outbound Bearer claims participate in Go principal consistency; unused ID tokens do not gate requests
Shared installation identity is not per-account UA/TLS fingerprint emulation
Managed Go account resolution prefers local ID, then exact auth-file ID, then API key plus canonical upstream URL; ambiguous evidence cannot authorize a different account
Go endpoint declarations agree with generated SDK configuration, including existing provider URL recovery
Go direct-provider transports retain inherited environment proxy bypass; explicit account or service routing remains authoritative
Record actual headers separately from the selected account local profile; neither confirms upstream receipt
Installation metadata has an independent capture flag; old Session/Thread records cannot imply metadata capture
Snapshots survive disabled or cleared body recording and database reopen; old records are never backfilled
Attempt metadata cannot merge across account or start-time boundaries; profile snapshots are owned copies
Only explicit identity fields are retained; credentials and full headers are not retained when body logging is disabled
Diagnostic snapshots never authorize a continuation or replace automatic-history completeness and caller/owner checks
Free Agent Identity remains eligible under restrictFreeAccounts; ordinary Free OAuth, reauthorization, web-session and explicit exclusion fences remain effective
Only inherited environment proxies honor NO_PROXY/no_proxy; uppercase takes precedence, including an explicitly empty uppercase value
IP and CIDR exclusions, wildcard IP bypass, HTTP requests and real WebSocket upgrades are covered by isolated local-network fixtures
The captured bypass policy participates in the transport digest, so new requests and WebSocket turns cannot reuse a stale policy; existing clients retain their captured policy
Explicit account, API service, global and OS proxy selections remain authoritative
Automatic complete-history admission retains caller/account isolation, immutable observed provenance and existing retry/resource limits
